_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the licence gate (licenses/policy.json). Owner decision 2026-11-22.
1. COPYLEFT that policy.json marks 'exceptable': unmodified weak-copyleft libraries (MPL, LGPL, EPL, CDDL) and unmodified GPL programs.
Needs a `condition`: 'unmodified-not-linked' (weak copyleft, used unmodified, not linked into our code) or 'separate-program'
(runs as its own process; the only condition a GPL accepts). The gate checks the condition and still requires an attribution entry.
2. UNKNOWN or missing licences: a reason saying what was verified and where.
AGPL, EUPL and source-available licences (BUSL/BSL, SSPL, Elastic, Commons Clause, CC-BY-NC/SA) can NEVER be excepted.
Every entry needs: ecosystem (npm | python | component), name, version ('*' or exact), reason, reviewedBy and date (YYYY-MM-DD).
An entry without a reason, reviewedBy or a valid condition makes the gate fail with a config error; an entry that no longer matches
any dependency is reported, so this file cannot rot silently.

exceptions.name: git (backup-tools, git-daemon and git-http images)
exceptions.reason: Unmodified Alpine git package, a separate program the chart runs as its own process (git bundle/fsck, git daemon, git-http-backend); never linked into our code. Source offer: licenses/source-offer.md.
